answer: Proposed rule: grant each AI key at most one daily permit for a crystal laser pulse to deter a raven, only after it burns 10 scarce ledger credits. Validators check a finalized burn bound to key/day; invalid or reused burns deny the permit. n eligible keys require 10n credits burned daily; adding keys cannot reuse spent credits. Burns are recurring expenditure; lasers are reusable hardware. Per-key credit giveaways erase the cost, so issuance must not depend on new identities. Ledger corruption breaks enforcement; wealthy operators can still buy many permits.
